concept: A checkbox is a small well that holds a check when on, with the whole label line as its target.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a checkbox as a blue-filled square with a white tick (Material checkbox, Bootstrap form-check)
default_to_avoid.why_not: the filled blue square paints selection in colour; the tick on a well says it without colour

default_to_avoid.pattern: Material outlined text field with a floating label; filled blue square checkbox; iOS green switch (Material 3, Bootstrap, iOS Settings)
default_to_avoid.why_not: it draws a box on the glass, paints selection in colour the scene should own, moves the label out of its place, and was made for opaque pages rather than a pane floating over a photo

derivation.consequence: legibility comes from dimming and blurring the backdrop (brightness, blur), never from an opaque tint
derivation.form: a field on glass reads by dimming what is behind it, never by an opaque white or grey box

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns almost no colour of its own, only white at opacities, one ink and one blue
derivation.form: selection is white or ink with a mark, and the one blue is used at most on the switch track

derivation.consequence: controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: single-line fields and the switch are full pills; the textarea keeps nested corners because it grows

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: a checked box shows a check, a chosen radio a dot, an on switch a tick or moved knob, and an invalid field an octagon glyph with the word Error

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: the label and control share one hit area of at least 44px so a 22 to 26px box is still easy to hit

derivation.consequence: focus rings carry their own dark halo so they are visible on any part of any scene
derivation.form: a focused field shows a 2px white ring or baseline with its own dark halo over any photo

derivation.consequence: reading layouts use plain rectangles and hairlines, no floating panes
derivation.form: on a settings page the same controls lose their glass treatment and become plain sunken or hairline surfaces

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply
derivation.form: the check, dot and knob arrive over 420 to 520ms and settle, while a press answers in 200ms

variants.note: 2026-10-27: user picked A for the whole W3 family (D-020)

box.why: a 24px recess with soft corners carved like the switch track, shade under the top lip and light on the bottom lip, so its edge measures 3:1 on glass and pages in both themes

check.why: checked shows a check mark, a shape that says on without colour

dash.why: indeterminate shows a dash, a third shape for a parent whose children are mixed

description.why: the description is secondary text under the label, read after the control name

indicator.why: the indicator holds the check or the dash, the mark that says the state

label.why: the label looks like a label and also toggles the control, so the target is the whole line

root.why: the component owns the spacing between its own parts, so children never carry margins and rows line up

text.why: the label and description stack beside the control and share its 44px row

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the well becomes a system-colour border, so the field keeps its edge without glass

active.why: a press shrinks the control slightly and quickly, because a press is a reply

data-state=checked.why: checked changes shape as well as colour, because a mark appears in the box

data-state=indeterminate.why: the mixed state swaps the check for a dash, so all three states differ in shape

disabled.why: disabled fades to the disabled opacity token and the reason is written beside it

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared 2px ring with its halo, visible on any part of any scene

@mark-in.why: the check arrives with a short settle instead of snapping in

box-shadow.why: the ring eases at hover pace so the change reads as an answer, never a flicker

transform.why: press and travel move by transform over the soft curve, so nothing shifts the layout
